chunks: When their brother Noah said to them: 'Will you not take heed?'

key_terms.تَتَّقُونَ: you take heed / you practice Taqwa
key_terms.نُوحٌ: Noah (peace be upon him), the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Noah say to his people in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'Akhu' (brother) underscores the universal nature of prophetic mission, where Noah (AS) appeals to both blood kinship and shared humanity to establish a foundation of trust before delivering the divine call to Taqwa. This verse illustrates the strategic use of relational closeness in da'wah, a method often cited by scholars to highlight the balance between authority and affection in inviting others to God. The emphasis on Taqwa here serves as the core objective of all prophetic messages, linking Noah's specific mission to the broader Quranic theme of moral consciousness.
